title: ESTIMETR Traceable BOQ Estimation Workspace
description: แทนหน้า ESTIMETR placeholder ด้วย workspace แบบมี QA gate ตามลำดับ ตรวจแบบ → ถอดปริมาณ → ประมาณราคา → สรุป BOQ โดยแสดง evidence, หน่วยวัด, ความพร้อมของแหล่งราคา และสถานะเอกสารอย่างตรงไปตรงมา.
scope: interactive ESTIMETR workspace with four gated stages
drawing/spec review, quantity evidence and unit-cost source states
BOQ readiness with private OH&P/profit/VAT context and separate government workflow context
workflow gate unit tests and browser/mobile validation record
verification: desktop stage progression and 375×812 mobile layout reviewed
security preflight, roadmap validation, diff check and public Vercel review pending
rollback: Return to tag v0.9.2-estimetr-terminology. This release has no migration, database write or user data to reverse.
constraints: Navigation links only use internal routes or anchors; no new auth/payment behavior is enabled.
Mobile navigation remains keyboard-reachable and horizontally scrollable without hiding the enterprise quote action.
Sticky navigation must not obstruct target section headings.
This workspace is a non-persistent demo: it must not present sample prices, quantities or export approval as a live business record.
